name: Vail Ranch Center
summary: Vail Ranch Center is a recently redeveloped 201,682 square foot community shopping center in Temecula that completed an $11 million renovation in 2024, adding Burlington Stores and Five Below to its strong tenant roster anchored by Stater Bros. The center draws over 4 million annual visits and ranks in the top 2% of its class, serving an affluent trade area with household incomes exceeding $147,000.
demographics: The trade area surrounding Vail Ranch Center serves an affluent and highly educated population, with average household incomes exceeding $147,000 within a 3-mile radius and 40% of residents holding college degrees. The center attracts a family-oriented demographic typical of Temecula's suburban communities, with households averaging higher income levels across all measured radii (1-mile: $155,441, 3-mile: $163,656, 5-mile: $160,587). With over 4 million annual visits and ranking in the top 2% of centers in its class for foot traffic, the property draws a mix of value-conscious shoppers seeking everyday necessities at Stater Bros and Harbor Freight Tools, alongside families looking for home goods, dining, and specialty services.
description: Vail Ranch Center is a premier community shopping destination in Temecula, California, strategically located at 31685-31845 Temecula Parkway with exceptional visibility from over 41,000 vehicles per day on Country Glen Way and 30,000 vehicles per day on Redhawk Parkway. This 201,682 square foot center recently completed an extensive $11 million redevelopment in 2024, adding major national retailers Burlington Stores and Five Below to complement the existing Stater Bros grocery anchor, transforming it into one of the most visited shopping centers in the Riverside-San Bernardino-Ontario market. The modernized center now draws an estimated 4 million annual visits and ranks in the top 2% of centers in its class within the market, serving an affluent trade area with average household incomes exceeding $147,000 within three miles. Vail Ranch Center offers an impressive tenant mix spanning grocery, home improvement, fitness, dining, and specialty retail, including Harbor Freight Tools, AutoZone, Dollar Tree, Kahoots Pet Products, and popular dining concepts like Cava, Dave's Hot Chicken, and Hana Sushi Restaurant. Situated directly across from the 140-bed Temecula Valley Hospital, the center benefits from strong demographics, high visibility, and convenient access for the surrounding residential communities in one of Southern California's fastest-growing markets.
